note: SOBEKDATA v104: Sobek secondary motion, PRESENTATION ONLY (read by Scripts/TailSpring.cs, LateUpdate after the Animator, render time only: no sim read, no RNG, simhash unchanged). Master switch `enabled` (false = TailSpring is never attached; ships dark, set true after a look). characters[].name = roster id; per row `enabled`. world: solver (maxSubstepS, maxSubsteps, maxFrameS), gravity, teleport snap, fade-in. chain: bones parents-first (names are the EXISTING fk_* / twist joints, re-parented in the Sobek glb only), stiffness 1/s^2, damping 1/s, gravity x world.gravityMps2, maxAngleDeg per bone, rootInfluence..tipInfluence blend along the chain (0 = animated pose), tipAxis/tipLengthM aim a bone that has no listed child. Every number is a (guess) start value to be tuned by eye; tipLengthM values are (measure) on the generated rig. Combat code must not read these bones.

follow._about: SOBEKTUNE v1: used ONLY by Tools-side tail_bake.py (baked into the clips, presentation only). Runtime TailSpring.cs (JsonUtility) ignores this block. stiffnessRoot/Tip = 1/s^2 pull toward the animated chain point, linear root to tip (Kaiju spring was 45 flat: too stiff to hang); gravityMul x world.gravityMps2; damping 1/s; maxAngleDeg per bone from its animated direction (no clamp = 180); floorM = metres above the floor the tail points may not go below (tail half-thickness, guess); stateStiffnessMul scales both stiffnesses per clip (death/knockdown: tail lets go and lies down); loopStates are simulated prerollPasses extra times so the loop seam is continuous. (guess) all, tuned by eye on the pose sheet. maxRootBendDeg = first bone vs the hips-animated direction; maxJointBendDeg = every later joint vs the previous segment around the animated bend (SOBEKTUNE measured: unlimited bends gave tail p99 stretch 2.0-2.2 and p01 compression 0.49-0.57 in death / get_up, the bind gate is 2.0 / 0.5).
